name: Awo Irin Illu
description: This city is known for innovation and has striking silver spires that shine in the sun. Its architecture combines geometric precision with functional elegance. The council here focuses on actionable plans rather than theories. Its people are practical, inclined toward engineering rather than philosophy, and favor combat training over sports and goods-producing and guard-duty golems rather than those that provide daily life amenities. Awo Irin is the most active city in reaching out to other species. They send emissaries carrying the city’s inventions rather than waiting for others to seek them. They actively pursue to shape the world according to their vision of the greater good. Most people in Awo Irin adhere to a philosophy of ethereal pragmatism, preferring to see results over intangible morals. T’ssir, who was born here, is part of the council and is currently discussing his view on blending individuals with magic and machines. Many still need to be convinced about the risks and advantages of this approach. The first tower of the Aetheric Synthesis Guild is located here, and it is from there that T’ssir exerts his influence over Tanares. Recently, several researchers and council members have died in what appear to be natural deaths, but the timing of these deaths is strange. Some believe these are coincidences, while others accuse the Cult of Shadow Wing, the Third Eye, or the Eldritch Hand. A few even point fingers at T’ssir, causing a great commotion, as such accusations are uncommon among taii’makus.
